book.title: The Bully Pulpit: Theodore Roosevelt, William Howard Taft, and the Golden Age of Journalism
book.description: Doris Kearns Goodwin, winner of the Pulitzer Prize and author of Team of Rivals, captures the Progressive Era through the story of the broken friendship between Theodore Roosevelt and William Howard Taft, culminating in their running against one another for president in 1912.
